name: Emeryville, California

coverage.summary: Retail firms with 56 or more employees globally, and fast food firms with 56 or more employees globally and 20 or more in Emeryville. Franchisees tied to a network of more than 12 locations are covered.
coverage.employerThreshold: 56+ employees globally (fast food: also 20+ in Emeryville)
coverage.employees: Employees who work at least 2 hours a week in Emeryville and are entitled to the California minimum wage. Exempt employees are not covered.

citation.quote: Covered Employers shall provide Employees with at least two weeks' notice of their Work Schedules ... at least every 14 days (on a Biweekly Schedule).

premiums.label: Hours cut or shift cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours to the Employee, four hours or the number of hours in the Employee's scheduled shift, whichever is less, when hours are canceled or reduced.

premiums.label: Hours added or shift moved with less than 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: With less than 24 hours to the Employee, one hour of Predictability Pay for all other changes.

premiums.label: Any change with less than 14 days' but at least 24 hours' notice

citation.quote: For each previously scheduled Shift that the Covered Employer adds or subtracts hours, moves to another date or time, cancels, or each previously unscheduled Shift that the Covered Employer adds: with less than 14 days' notice, but 24 hours or more notice to the Employee, one hour of Predictability Pay.

An Employee who agrees in writing to work hours described in this Section shall be compensated at one-and-a-half times the Employee's regular rate of pay for any hours worked less than 11 hours following the end of a previous shift.

exceptions.label: Work couldn't begin or continue
exceptions.description: Threats or a civil authority's recommendation, a utility or sewer failure, or an act of nature, war, civil unrest, strikes or other cause outside the employer's control, for the time operations could not run.

exceptions.label: Shift swap or coverage I agreed to with a coworker
exceptions.description: Mutually agreed shift swaps or coverage between employees.

exceptions.label: I stayed to finish a sale for commission or tips
exceptions.description: Working past the end of the shift to finish a sale that earns a commission or tips, paid at the regular rate.

exceptions.label: I asked for this change
exceptions.description: Employee-initiated voluntary changes, such as asking to leave early.

exceptions.label: I was paid overtime worth more than the premium
exceptions.description: Overtime paid for the change exceeds the predictability pay otherwise owed.

exceptions.label: I was sent home but paid for the whole shift
exceptions.description: The employer paid for the full scheduled shift.

otherRights.label: Right to decline hours less than 11 hours after your previous day's shift
Extra hours must be offered to current part-time employees first

enforcement.agency: City of Emeryville, Fair Workweek enforcement

sources.title: Emeryville Municipal Code ch. 5-39 (Fair Workweek Employment Standards)
City of Emeryville: Fair Workweek Ordinance (FAQ, poster, regulations)

notes: Starting or ending within 10 minutes of the scheduled time is exempt (§ 5-39.04(d)(5)(b)); Shiftowed applies this as an 11-minute threshold.
The city's FAQ describes the short-notice cut as the lesser of 4 hours or the remaining hours of the shift; Shiftowed follows the code's wording (the hours in the scheduled shift).
The rest premium is time and a half on the hours inside the 11-hour window. Shiftowed shows the extra half-time.
